rules.text: a template matches only against SUPPLIED root radicals filling R1..R3 in order; no root is derived here
a matched row names degree, not identity: the intensive reading asserts habitual, professional or excessive performance and is never claimed for a single-occasion act
the closing taa of the فعالة row is declared intensifying, so this unit emits NO gender claim from it; gender is read from agreement elsewhere in the clause

the فعيل and فعول rows are declared shared with the quality-adjective inventory; the transitivity test (can an underlying verb with an object be recovered?) is SUPPLIED evidence and is not run by the consumer
the مفعال row is letter-identical to the instrument template and the فعلة row is letter-identical to a nominal template; both homographs are declared, so those skeletons abstain ambiguous_template
an annexed noun following an intensive form corresponds to the source verb's object; this unit flags the annexation for review and never re-analyses the clause
the six-row grouping is one of several competing traditions and the classical restriction to transitive triliteral verbs is recorded as unstated in the source; the inventory is candidate, not closed

every realization of a weak radical (و، ي) is licensed per template, slot and radical by weak_realizations.by_template: an altered letter must appear in that entry's substituted list, and a weak radical may stand literally only where literal_licensed is true; nothing is licensed by default — an uncontracted hollow/weak shape is not a classification

every weak radical of the matched template requires the exact bound declaration (weak_position + weak_radical) -> otherwise weak_declaration_unbound; an unlicensed realization -> weak_realization_unlicensed; a declared weak position/radical the supplied radicals do not bear -> weak_declaration_contradicts_root

a matched row whose declared class begins with shared_ never resolves to that class here: the consumer abstains shared_row_class_undecided (the label is a routing hint, not a class the letters alone decide)

weak_realizations.licensing_note: DELIBERATELY MINIMAL. No realization of a weak radical is licensed for any template in this increment: no committed fixture in this pack evidences a licensed substitution or a licensed literal weak realization, so every weak radical of a matched template abstains (weak_declaration_unbound or weak_realization_unlicensed). Widening this table is a linguistic decision for the ṣarf authority (adp-sarf-nahw-authority), made in DATA — no consumer edit is required to license a further realization.
